description: GCP Network ImportData — VPC + subnetwork + Cloud NAT topology.

cidrBlock.description: Primary subnetwork CIDR block used for internal firewall rules.

isByoVpc.description: True when the VPC is owned outside this stack.

routerSelfLink.description: Cloud Router self-link backing Cloud NAT (when created).

oneOf.description:
Setup-owned network attachment and egress gateway VMs for Internet sandboxes. Absent for a
deployment without them, and for setup releases that predate them.

attachmentCidr.description: Range of the attachment's own subnet. Sandbox traffic enters the VPC from it.

gatewayCidr.description: Range of the gateway subnet, the only one with Cloud NAT.

gatewayIps.description: Static private IPs of the gateway VMs, one per replica.

networkAttachment.description:
Full path of the network attachment sandbox templates name:
`projects/{project}/regions/{region}/networkAttachments/{name}`.

proxyPort.description:
The tcp port the gateway's proxy answers sandboxes on. The admin port is never reachable
from the attachment range.

vpcCidrs.description: Every VPC range, excluded from gateway destinations.

subnetSelfLinks.description: Subnetwork self-links across the configured regions.

vpcSelfLink.description:
VPC self-link. Absent when the controller will look up the
default network at runtime.
